upd.lead: Fetches the drop tables, enemy and bounty sources, Riven prices and the name dictionary (including Riven dispositions and simulator data). Run it again after game updates.
upd.plus: Also fetch Syndicate, quest reward and vendor sources (unofficial Export Plus)
upd.plus.note: Fetched from calamity-inc/warframe-public-export-plus (unofficial data built from the game files). The choice is remembered when you fetch and used next time (the update command follows it too). Fetching with it turned off removes what was fetched before.
upd.vendors.note: Items from the checked vendors are shown as sources (applied right away). "Unnamed" vendors were added by game updates or similar; their names are built from the data.
upd.note: Sources: drop tables and sources come from WFCD/warframe-drop-data (drops.warframestat.us), names from calamity-inc/warframe-public-export (or the official Public Export if that fails), and Riven prices from the official weeklyRivensPC.json (or WFCD's api.warframestat.us). If the logo has not been fetched yet, it is also fetched from the official Warframe Fan Kit. An internet connection is required.
upd.broken.v: {files} (fetch them again with "Fetch official data" below)
upd.fetching.log: Fetching. This can take a few tens of seconds...
